description.en: The CNAME record that you want to reuse for the website.

description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

description.zh:
是否开启CNAME复用。取值：
- **0**：关闭
- **1**：开启
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable CNAME reuse. Valid values:

*   **0:** disabled
*   **1:** enabled

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 为网站业务开启或关闭CNAME复用

descriptions.zh: > 该接口仅适用于DDoS高防（非中国内地）服务。
descriptions.en: > This operation is suitable only for Anti-DDoS Premium.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-cname-reuse --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --cname 4o6ep6q217k90000.aliyunddos0004.com --enable 1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
